item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J00545","case1_error":"Subtracts only Ryan’s quarter-share, omitting Chris’s withdrawal.","case2_error":"Subtracts losses from an already final balance; also equates wins with rounds played, whose total is underdetermined.","reason":"The first omits a required withdrawal. The second mishandles the balance, but unspecified losing rounds make the requested total materially ambiguous.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J00546","case1_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 120/2 as 60/2 = 30, then gives an unsupported final answer of 15.","case2_error":"Provides an unsupported final total of 500 after correct formulas and an explicit four-week assumption; those imply 200.","reason":"The first visibly miscalculates a correctly written average; the second supplies a wrong number without showing its numerical evaluation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00547","case1_error":"Reverses Ida’s price relation, writing J−30 instead of J+30, then substitutes unsupported prices for Ida and Patty.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates the correctly written subtraction 140−85 as 45 instead of 55.","reason":"The first misrepresents a stated relationship and arbitrarily changes prices; the second makes a numerical evaluation error.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00548","case1_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 35×0.2857 as 9.5; the exact proportional expression 35×2/7 equals 10.","case2_error":"Replaces the stated one plank per leg with three planks per leg, inflating the material requirement.","reason":"The first miscalculates a valid proportional expression; the second changes a given quantity before calculating.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00549","case1_error":"Gives unsupported profit of $100 despite formulas implying $180; additionally writes a profit-per-mile expression missing necessary parentheses.","case2_error":"Subtracts the cost of only one necklace from revenue for 30 necklaces, omitting costs for the other 29.","reason":"The first supplies an unexplained wrong final number and malformed per-mile expression; the second fails to scale production costs to the number sold.","judgment":"different"}]}
